headline: US stocks set to open higher as AI earnings momentum underpins futures ahead of PPI and jobless claims with oil prices mixed amid Iran-related energy tensions
raw_text:
- S&P 500 (@ES), Dow (@YM), Nasdaq 100 (@NQ) and Russell 2000 (@ER2) futures trade modestly higher, pointing to a positive open led by AI-related strength
- Super Micro Computer (SMCI) gains roughly 1–2% pre-market after an EPS beat, strong AI server demand and a guidance raise in its August 12 results
- CoreWeave (CRWV) trades lower pre-market after reporting a revenue beat with 112% revenue growth, narrower losses, upgraded guidance and a $104B backlog despite a net loss
- NBIS (NBIS) declines around 4% pre-market after posting more than 450% Q2 revenue growth
- Dell Technologies (DELL) trades higher pre-market while Aehr Test Systems (AEHR) and Astronics (ATRO) are mixed, benefiting from AI infrastructure momentum
- Cisco Systems (CSCO) falls about 6% pre-market following its latest company update
- Cerebras (CBRS) drops around 17% pre-market after its recent update
- Coherent (COHR) declines roughly 5% pre-market following its latest update
- At 8:30 AM ET, the US reports PPI, expected around 4.9% year over year, alongside weekly initial jobless claims
- Asian markets advance with the Nikkei (@NKD) and Kospi higher on chip strength, while European equities edge up and crude oil (@CL) weakens amid ongoing energy and Iran-related geopolitical tensions
